caption:
her plan, her words. soma just runs the calendar

#routine #fitnessapp #soma

slides.text:
My coach sends the plan
as a *photo*

Every Sunday

Screenshot, whiteboard,
a text

It reads them all

The workout, in her words

Not rewritten. Hers

Then it shows up
inside the daily plan

Sessions on her days

A plan you already trust

Finally with a scheduler

slides.heading: Bring your coach's plan
slides.body: Photograph the assignment — SOMA fills the form, keeps the coach's words verbatim, and schedules the block
